description: Codex-shaped mirror of hooks/hooks.json (the Claude Code plugin hook). Codex's plugin.json schema has no `hooks` key — a Codex plugin install does not auto-wire hooks the way a Claude Code plugin does. This file is REFERENCE WIRING only: a Codex host activates it by merging this `Stop` entry into the project's own .codex/hooks.json at the repo root (same JSON shape Codex reads for project-level hooks). See AGENTS.md `## Hooks` for the full explanation and the merge command.
